method: season-to-date herbaceous NPP percentile vs the county's own rolling 10-year RAP baseline
vr_data_note: VR is the percentile rank of this year's season-to-date rangeland (NLCD 52+71) herbaceous productivity against the prior 9 years. RAP's 16-day NPP is released with a lag, so early each season the current year has no data yet and VR is reported as null with a vr_status of 'awaiting_current_year_rap'; the forage score uses the soil-moisture proxy until RAP publishes. Each county also carries vr_status and vr_note explaining any null.
resolution_note: Percentiles are computed over a 10-year window, so their resolution is coarse (~10 points); read them as broad bands, not exact ranks.
hay_pasture_note: Irrigated Hay/Pasture (NLCD 81) -- NDVI greenness vs local normal (beta); separate from the Rangeland Forage Condition score, never folded into VR/mi/score.
